EV1.independent_derivation: Reflect q across x=d to -q at x=d-a. Exclude real self-field for force; field distances at d+2a are a and 3a.

EV2.independent_derivation: Sphere image q_im=-qa/d at a²/d; separation d-a²/d. Coulomb force q*q_im/separation²; grounded net image charge equals conductor charge.

EV3.independent_derivation: Off-center image -qa/d cancels boundary variation. Central image Qs+qa/d fixes net charge; its boundary potential is k*qc/a.

EV4.independent_derivation: Vector sum k*q*(a,b,0)/D³ + k*(-2q)*(-a,b,0)/D³; scalar potentials add.

EV5.independent_derivation: Qenc=4pi*rho0*(r³/3-r⁴/(4a)). E=Qenc/(4pi eps r²); integrate inward from V(a)=rho0*a²/(12eps). Test force qE and test potential energy qV.

EV6.independent_derivation: Cylindrical gradient gives Es=-2ksz and Ez=-ks²; Laplacian (1/s)d(s*dV/ds)/ds+d²V/dz²=4kz, rho=-eps*laplacian.

BA1.independent_derivation: curl(0,0,ky)=(k,0,0); M×ex=(0,ky,0), evaluated at y=b. No H or B inferred.

BA2.independent_derivation: Demagnetizing H=-M/3, Binside=2mu*M/3. Moment=4pi*a³*M/3; at z=3a and M perpendicular to z, B=-mu*M/81.

BA4.independent_derivation: At (0,b), x components of opposite z currents cancel; y components add to mu*I*a/[pi(a²+b²)].

BA5.independent_derivation: A circular arc subtending pi/2 produces mu*I*angle/(4pi*a), oriented +z by dl×r. Return wire excluded in question.

DYN1.independent_derivation: Solve L Iprime+R I=V: I=V/R+(I0-V/R)exp(-t/tau). Initial slope from KVL; zero from exponential ratio, positive and finite.

DYN2.independent_derivation: Integrating factor exp(t/tau) gives I=(v0/L)t exp(-t/tau). Derivative vanishes at tau; second derivative there is -v0*R*exp(-1)/L²<0, a local maximum.

DYN3.independent_derivation: Integrating factor for Qprime+Q/(RC)=beta*t/R gives Q=beta*C*(t-tau+tau exp(-t/tau)); differentiate for positive charging current.

DYN4.independent_derivation: B(t)*A(t)=B0*A0*(1+t/T); both time dependences are included before differentiation. emf=-N*B0*A0/T, I=emf/R, negative: clockwise viewed from +z.

DYN5.independent_derivation: emf=alpha. Current from integrating-factor RL solution. Joule power=R*I²; integrate (alpha²/R)(1-2e^-t/tau+e^-2t/tau) from 0 to T.

DYN6.independent_derivation: v=(0,omega*u,0), B=(0,0,B0), v×B=(omega*u*B0,0,0); integral from 0 to a is positive B0*omega*a²/2, tip positive.

EV7.independent_derivation: Well-posed exterior Laplace/Poisson boundary problem with zero potential on six finite faces, decay at infinity and a point-charge singularity. The planar-image solution does not satisfy all cube faces; a separately validated numerical boundary solver is required. No value invented.

BA6.independent_derivation: Ampere fixes average H=NI/ell, but without a material relation and hysteresis state B is not unique. At the same H, distinct remanent states can give different B.

DYN7.independent_derivation: KVL gives Qsecond+2Qprime+100Q=0. Roots -1 +/- i*sqrt(99). Q(t)=exp(-t)*(cos(sqrt(99)*t)+sin(sqrt(99)*t)/sqrt(99)) C, Icharge=dQ/dt=-100*exp(-t)*sin(sqrt(99)*t)/sqrt(99) A. Q(0)=1, I(0)=0; no matching model card was forced onto it.
